quiz.question: At 82.4s in the video, which expression best completes: "She felt very strongly that I should be adopted by college ________, so everything was all set for me to."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 82.4 秒處，講者說：「她非常強烈地認為我應該被大學畢業生收養，所以一切都為我準備好了。」，空格中應填入哪個道地字詞或片語？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「She felt very strongly that I should be adopted by college graduates, so everything was all set for me to.」（她非常強烈地認為我應該被大學畢業生收養，所以一切都為我準備好了。）。家教解析：「graduate (v./n.)」意為「畢業（動詞發音為 /-eɪt/，必搭配介系詞 graduate from + 學校；名詞「畢業生」發音則弱化為 /-ət/）」。

quiz.question: At 233.1s in the video, which expression best completes: "I learned about serif and san serif typefaces, about varying the amount of space between different letter ________."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 233.1 秒處，講者說：「我了解了襯線和無襯線字體，以及改變不同字母組合之間的空格量。」，空格中應填入哪個道地字詞或片語？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「I learned about serif and san serif typefaces, about varying the amount of space between different letter combinations.」（我了解了襯線和無襯線字體，以及改變不同字母組合之間的空格量。）。家教解析：「combination (n.)」意為「組合（字首 co-/con- 表「共同、整合」）」。

quiz.question: At 401.1s in the video, which expression best completes: "I felt that I had let the previous generation of ________."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 401.1 秒處，講者說：「我覺得我已經讓上一代企業家了。」，空格中應填入哪個道地字詞或片語？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「I felt that I had let the previous generation of entrepreneurs.」（我覺得我已經讓上一代企業家了。）。家教解析：「entrepreneur (n.)」意為「創業家、企業家（源自法語，注意字尾發音為 /-ˈnɝ/；衍生字 entrepreneurship 指「創業精神」）」。

quiz.question: At 767.0s in the video, which expression best completes: "And most important, have the courage to follow your heart and ________."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 767.0 秒處，講者說：「最重要的是，要有勇氣跟隨你的心和直覺。」，空格中應填入哪個道地字詞或片語？
